Warlords of New York Manhunt

The Lower Manhattan campaign that sends SHD Agents after Aaron Keener following the biological attack attributed to him.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision game universe Canon scopegame canon Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

Campaign response

The Warlords campaign is framed as SHD's response to the Lower Manhattan attack: Agents pursue Keener through an open-ended campaign whose investigation threads connect the main and side missions. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Ubisoft's Warlords of New York overview says SHD Agents are sent to Lower Manhattan after a biological attack to hunt Aaron Keener and stop further attacks. [1]

  2. confirmed

    The same official overview describes five investigation threads that link main and side missions, including five main missions and eight side missions. [1]
